content: _Chlamydia pneumoniae_ is a type of bacteria that can cause infections in the respiratory tract. These infections are typically mild in nature. Infections caused by _Chlamydia pneumoniae_ can sometimes occur without any noticeable symptoms. However, when symptoms are present, they can vary widely in their clinical presentation. The exact number of individuals affected by _Chlamydia pneumoniae_ infections each year remains unknown. Diagnostic testing for _Chlamydia pneumoniae_ infections can be performed using a variety of laboratory methods. Healthcare professionals can submit specimens to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) for testing. Detailed instructions are available to guide the submission process.
